basic_info.description: Life at the Top of Telegraph Hill - 117 Telegraph Hill is one of San Francisco's most anticipated new residences, perched high atop Telegraph Hill beside the iconic Coit Tower. This multi-level modern masterpiece offers a rare opportunity to live at the topliterallywith sweeping, front-row views of the Bay Bridge, skyline, Nob Hill, and beyond. Spanning approximately 4,180 sq. ft., the home includes 4 bedrooms, 4 full and 2 half bathrooms. The main level welcomes you with a grand living room, fireplace, panoramic views, an office, and powder room. An elevator and light-filled central staircase connect all levels. The second floor features a view-side chef's kitchen, dining room, powder room, and ensuite bedroom. The third level is home to the luxurious primary suite with spa-like bath, walk-in closet, and a second ensuite bedroom. A rooftop deck crowns the homeideal for entertaining above it all. The lower level offers a large family room opening to a landscaped deck lounge, an additional ensuite bedroom, laundry room, and powder room. Additional highlights include a private gated garage, solar power, and custom designer finishes. A rare combination of privacy, luxury, and location at the apex of the city.
